emails.subject: URGENT Action Required: Overdue Data Queries for Study PNCL-201 at Site 101 - Approaching Database Lock
emails.body:
Dear Maria,

I hope this email finds you well.

I am writing to follow up on the significant number of overdue data queries for study PNCL-201 at University Health Center. As of this morning, there are 127 queries outstanding for more than 30 days in the Medidata Rave EDC system.

As you know, we are rapidly approaching the database lock for the Part A interim analysis, scheduled for November 15th. It is critical that all data is clean and all queries are resolved well in advance of this deadline to ensure data integrity for the analysis.

I have attached a line listing of the overdue queries for your convenience. Could you please review this list and provide a plan for resolution by the end of this week? Please let us know what resources you need and if there are any major issues preventing your team from addressing these.

We are happy to schedule a call to walk through the queries if that would be helpful.

Thank you for your immediate attention to this critical matter.

Best regards,

Sarah Jenkins
Clinical Research Associate
Pinnacle Pharma
sarah.jenkins@pinnaclepharma.com

emails.subject: Re: URGENT Action Required: Overdue Data Queries for Study PNCL-201 at Site 101 - Approaching Database Lock
emails.body:
Hi Sarah,

Thank you for your email and for providing the query list. My apologies for the delay in resolving these.

We have had some unexpected staffing shortages over the past month which has led to this backlog. I have reviewed the list with Dr. Miller, and we have prioritized this task. I will be dedicating my time exclusively to resolving these queries for the remainder of this week and next.

Our plan is to have at least 60% of the queries resolved by EOD Tuesday, October 31st, with the remainder completed by Monday, November 6th. This should give us ample time before the database lock.

I will provide you with a status update on Tuesday.

Best,

Maria Garcia
Clinical Data Manager
University Health Center

emails.subject: Re: URGENT Action Required: Overdue Data Queries for Study PNCL-201 at Site 101 - Approaching Database Lock
emails.body:
Hi Maria,

Thank you for the prompt response and for outlining your plan. We understand that staffing issues can be challenging, and we appreciate you prioritizing this.

The timeline you've proposed is acceptable. Please keep us updated on your progress, and don't hesitate to reach out if you encounter any queries that require clarification from our data management or medical monitoring teams.

We look forward to your update on Tuesday.

Thanks again for your commitment to resolving this.

Best regards,

Sarah Jenkins
Clinical Research Associate
Pinnacle Pharma
sarah.jenkins@pinnaclepharma.com

description: A thread with a site's data manager to address a large backlog of overdue data queries in the EDC system, emphasizing the need for timely resolution before an upcoming database lock for a Part A analysis.
